rules.precedence: Gemma anatomy > ARCHS4 source > characteristics/GEO description > title > protocols > study context
rules.boundaries: negative alphanumeric lookarounds; no raw substring matching
rules.ambiguity: multiple labels at strongest evidence tier returns ambiguous
rules.specificity: listed child label suppresses its broad parent only within the same field
rules.study_context: used only if no stronger sample-level or Gemma evidence exists

limitations: Direct anatomical aliases only; cell-type-to-organ inference is intentionally excluded.
Unknown means no recognized 54-category alias, not proof that the source contains no free-text anatomical clue.
GEOMeta ground truth is human-only, so held-out precision is not independently established for mouse.
